# LastRound.io

> Free online multiplayer trick-taking card game. Play instantly in your browser. No download, no signup required.

## About

LastRound is an original pirate-themed trick-taking card game for 2–6 players.
Play free in any modern browser — no app install, no account required.
The #1 Free Online Skull King Alternative.

Features:
- Instant multiplayer: create a room and share the link
- 2–6 players per game
- Trick-taking with bidding, special pirate cards, and strategic depth
- Works on desktop and mobile browsers
- No downloads, no sign-ups, completely free

## Links

- Play Now: https://lastround.io/
